gaps.missing: the landing contract (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/ot_s81_land.sv header) anchors the write epoch on "the hop-0 forward cell is a clock gate opened at source edge G by the source released reset"; die.v has no such gate (0 gate cells; 140 BUFx8 fwd cells + slice ck outputs, all free-running). The write counter wc then starts at the RECEIVER reset release, so wc and rc run in lockstep and the flight-time part of K is lost: every landing with K >= D (D 4: all xr ring lanes K 4/5, tvS_gunit K4; D 8 276l lanes with K >= 8) reads a ring slot already overwritten -> land_fault at warm-up (K edges after rs release, no traffic) and the lane word leaves 4 edges early.

resolution.generator: every LANDED lane gets a hop-0 clock gate ICGx4_ASAP7_75t_R fwd_<lane> (CLK = source root or the slice ck_line, ENA = released reset); gate calendar R0 = G + (N mod 2) per lane (G = first gated source edge, R0 = first landing read edge, N relay stations), realised with dsfd_rly_1 calendar stations on whichever side would release early (619 stations, 224 gates on p4l); K = E unchanged, no tile changes; SE strap
resolution.bench: dv_slice_cut --land-plan now models lane flight as whole cycles on the gated lane clock (dv_flight_sim: data and first clock edge both F cycles late, F = ceil(-S1/T) clipped to [E-D+1, E-1]); Verilator 5.050 drops transport-delayed clock pulses. dv_slice_tb asserts rst_n at 0.1 ns (an edge) so async clears reach stopped gated clocks

gaps.missing: die.v straps sid = 2*col + tier(N=1) (u_s_3S 6, u_s_4S 8; tools/s81_dv/svc_rs/svc_rs_embed.py sid(rc) = 2c + r, and ot_s81sl_xr indexes the slice mask by sid), but ot_s81sl_rstop decodes sid as {tier, col} (col = sid[2:0], tier = sid[3]): u_s_4S is decoded as column 0 / tier N, so its W line default is 0 hops (a seq_host CTL beat re-injected by 4S is skipped westward), u_s_3S as column 6 (own beats E 1 hop / W 6 hops), and map_e/map_w (NX snake ends) select the wrong slices.
evidence: RTL reading (static); the 3S replay assumed the intended 4S output (hops = col 4); the CTL-path cut (seq_host + bk_sel + u_s_4S + u_s_3S, prepared: scratch cut_3S_ctl 2,148 instances) would witness it
gaps.note: one of the two conventions must change; the compiler (dv_layer_compile.py) uses sid = 2c + r
